description: Nationale stiptheid gemeten met afgeschafte treinen is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. Het stiptheidspercentage geeft weer hoeveel procent van alle binnenlandse treinen, over een periode van een maand, met een vertraging van maximaal 5 minuten en 59 seconden aangekomen zijn in hun eindbestemmingsstation (voor de treinen die door de Brusselse Noord-Zuid verbinding rijden, geldt het eerste station van de Brusselse Noord-Zuid verbinding dat zij op hun reisweg ... Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Traffic beheer. Its keywords are Stiptheid, Afgeschafte treinen, Binnenlandse treinen, Reizigers. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
